name: Theodar
description: A warrior who strode the battle lines snatching swords with his bare hands.

description_citations.text: Chronicles: card flavor text (Chronicles, 1995), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Theodar strides the battle lines snatching swords bare-handed until all cower before him.
timeline.quote: Theodar strode the battle lines, snatching swords with his bare hands and casting them aside until all cowered before him.
